citaat: Filippo Carnevali confirmed that writing assignments remain central to assessment and evaluation at the University of Ferrara, appearing in both coursework and final exams.
samenvatting: Schrijfopdrachten staan centraal in hun toetsing, dus ons product past.

citaat: The university has not adopted strict guidelines or AI detector tools, as professors decided these approaches have inherent limitations with rapidly evolving AI models. Some professors conduct in-person classroom assessments with laptops to oversee student work directly.
samenvatting: Geen detectietools, ze lossen integriteit op met toezicht en afspraken.

citaat: Writing assignments remain central because they combat potential brain rot from AI overuse and are considered superior to oral exams for scaling to large student populations.
samenvatting: Zij zien mondeling juist niet als schaalbaar alternatief, schrijven blijft leidend.

citaat: Students are increasingly interested in AI technologies for receiving initial feedback on written assignments.
samenvatting: Studenten halen hun eerste feedback al bij AI, de vraag komt van onderop.

citaat: Filippo highlighted the absence of learning analytics from current AI tools, making it difficult to identify which topics students struggle with or need clarification.
samenvatting: Ze missen zicht op waar studenten vastlopen, dat is zijn eigen haakje.

citaat: Filippo noted professors remain suspicious of AI-based assessment software, viewing it as controversial and not yet widely accepted at the university. The university is still in the awareness phase, training professors on artificial intelligence fundamentals.
samenvatting: Docenten wantrouwen AI-beoordeling, de instelling zit nog in de bewustwordingsfase.

citaat: The new AI department acts as a filter and evaluation body, with decision-making authority over technology adoption, pilot organization, and budget allocation. Filippo can flag software to the AI department but cannot make final adoption decisions independently.
samenvatting: Ons contact mag alleen doorspelen, het nieuwe AI-departement beslist en betaalt.

citaat: Dante introduced Eduface's AI Integrity Checker, designed to verify students understand assignment content through rapid oral examinations with an AI agent, assessing knowledge rather than authorship. Pilot testing showed students prepare thoroughly when aware of oral examinations.
samenvatting: Wij positioneerden mondeling als kennistoets, niet als detectie van auteurschap.

citaat: Due to various ongoing initiatives and our current inability to provide specific training to students or teachers on the use of new AI tools, we are concerned that we would not be able to dedicate the necessary attention and resources to a potential pilot project.
samenvatting: Ze durven geen pilot aan omdat ze docenten en studenten niet kunnen trainen.

citaat: At the moment we will not be investing in this direction. I'll let you know if anything changes.
samenvatting: Harde nee op investering, zonder inhoudelijk bezwaar, puur prioriteit.

citaat: We're overwhelmed of projects so unfortunately we're not able to dedicate much time to new things. I hope this will change soon.
samenvatting: Projectdruk is hier de echte concurrent, niet een andere tool.
